description:
Consultant Middleware & EDI Profile

Middleware Responsibilities

  • Monitoring of interfaces (AEX, dual-stack if applicable)
  • Error analysis and resolution (mapping, adapters, proxies, IDoc, RFC, SOAP, REST)
  • Performance analysis and tuning
  • Certificate management (SSL, keystores, renewals)
  • Log analysis (Message Monitoring, NWA, SXMB_MONI, RWB)
  • Housekeeping and queue management

EDI Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and operation of the EDI platform
  • Partner onboarding (communication parameters, certificates, mappings)
  • Support and maintenance of EDI standards (EDIFACT, ANSI X12, VDA, XML)
  • Error analysis in mapping and communication processes
  • Configuration and monitoring of AS2 / OFTP2 / SFTP
  • Certificate management (e.g. AS2 certificates)
  • Archiving and traceability (audit compliance)


Professional Profile

  • Hands-on mentality, strong teamwork skills, and excellent communication abilities at all organizational levels

Middleware Expertise

  • Design, configuration, and monitoring of integration scenarios in a middleware environment
    (ESR, Integration Directory, Adapter Framework)
  • Experience with common adapters (IDoc, RFC, File, SOAP, REST, JDBC)
  • Message monitoring, alerting, and performance analysis
  • Strong knowledge of XML, XSD, WSDL, XPath, and mappings (graphical and Java mapping)
  • Confident handling of certificate management, TLS/SSL, keystore administration, and transport protocols

EDI Expertise

  • Experience in operating and administering an EDI landscape (e.g. Seeburger BIS)
  • Implementation and support of EDI mappings
  • Experience with standards such as EDIFACT, ANSI X12, VDA, and XML-based formats
  • Configuration and monitoring of communication protocols (AS2, OFTP2, SFTP)
  • Partner onboarding including communication parameters and certificate management
  • End-to-end error analysis across the entire EDI process chain
    (communication, conversion, mapping, SAP integration)
